definitions.gloss: see you later; see you again
definitions.explanation: A friendly, casual way to say goodbye with the implication of meeting again.

examples.japanese: またね！⟦{楽|たの}しかった→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: See you later! It was fun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありがとう→ありがとう：00917_arigatou⟧。またね。
examples.english: Thanks for today. See you later.
I said "see you" before hanging up the phone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{別|わか}れる→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧、「またね」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}った→振る：01983_furu⟧。
examples.english: When parting with my friend at the station, I waved and said "see you later."

notes:
またね comes from ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧ (again) + ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ (sentence-ending particle), literally meaning "again, okay?" It implies you expect to see the person again.

REGISTER:
Casual and friendly. Used among friends, family, and peers. Not appropriate in formal situations — use ⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧します or ⟦さようなら→さようなら：10531_sayounara⟧ instead.

FORMS:
- またね: standard casual goodbye
- ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧: even more casual (dropping ね)
- また⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧ね: see you tomorrow
- また⟦{今度|こんど}→今度：01327_kondo⟧ね: see you next time
- また⟦{会|あ}おう→会う：00482_au⟧ね: let's meet again (slightly warmer)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦じゃあね→じゃあね：05305_jaane⟧: see you (casual, slightly more abrupt)
- バイバイ: bye-bye (casual, younger speakers)
- ⟦さようなら→さようなら：10531_sayounara⟧: goodbye (formal; can imply a longer separation)
- ⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧します: goodbye (polite/formal, workplace)
